# Cognito System

> Cognito System is an exam-focused study app for iPhone and iPad. It turns a syllabus, topic, PDF, image, recording, YouTube video, webpage, arXiv paper, or notes into practice shaped around the exam a learner is preparing for, then schedules reviews with FSRS spaced repetition.

## Key facts
- Brand: Cognito System (also called Cognito)
- Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS/iPadOS 18 or later
- Category: Education and exam preparation
- Availability: Free to start. The free tier includes unlimited hand-made cards, FSRS scheduling, Classic and Compact study, image occlusion, Anki import, every accent theme, analytics charts, widgets, optional iCloud sync, and 10 AI generations per calendar month. Premium (weekly, monthly or yearly) lifts the generation cap and adds Voice AI Tutor, Quiz and Type Answer study, deck translation, AI rewrite and mnemonic hints, auto-play review, AI Coach, streak protection and smart reminders. Prices are shown in local App Store currency.
- Exam support: More than 80 school, university, admissions, professional, and medical exam formats
- Study modes: Classic, Compact, Quiz, and Typed Answer
- Scheduling: FSRS spaced repetition
- Sources: topics, PDFs, images, audio, YouTube, webpages, arXiv papers, and notes
- Rich content: LaTeX, code, tables, Mermaid diagrams, cloze cards, image occlusion, and text-to-speech
- Other features: Tutor, Voice Tutor, Skill Trees, Daily Mix, Weak Spots, analytics, widgets, and optional iCloud sync
- Data model: cards, decks, progress, history, and settings are local-first; supported data can be synced through the user's private iCloud/CloudKit database
- Developer and operator: Aleksei Usanov

## Important qualifications
- Cognito is independent and is not endorsed by or affiliated with exam boards or testing organizations.
- AI-generated content should be checked against the current syllabus and authoritative sources.
- Medical content is for study only and is not medical advice or clinical decision support.
